data.long_meaning: The name Cyrielle is derived from the Greek name Kyrielle, which is a feminine form of Kyrios, meaning 'Lord'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cyrielle usually hope their child will grow to embody sun of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: סיריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סיריאל נגזר מהשורש היווני קיריוס (Κύριος) שמשמעותו אדון או שולט, ומהסופית הצרפתית -אלה שמשמעותה אל או אלוהים. השם מורכב מהמילה היוונית קיריוס שפירושה אדון, ומהמילה העברית אל שפירושה אלוהים. השם סיריאל משמש כנראה כנשמה החיה של האלוהים או ככוח הרוחני של האל.

in_greek.name: Κυριέλλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κυριέλλ αποτελείται από το ελληνικό Κύριος που σημαίνει Κύριος ή αφέντης, και από την γαλλική κατάληξη -έλλ που σημαίνει φως ή λάμψη. Το όνομα Κυριέλλ πιθανόν να σημαίνει το φως του Κυρίου ή την λάμψη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Cyrielle
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cyrielle derivatur ex verbo Graeco Κύριος (Kyrios) quod significat Dominus vel Imperator, et ex terminatione Gallica -elle quae significat lux vel splendor. Nomen Cyrielle probabiliter significat lucem Domini vel splendorem Dei.

in_english.name: Cyrielle
in_english.meaning: Lordly light or God is my lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cyrielle originates from the Greek word Κύριος (Kyrios) meaning Lord or Master, and the French suffix -elle meaning light or radiance. It signifies the light of the Lord or God's radiance. The name symbolizes spiritual illumination, divine guidance, and a strong connection to one's faith. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in Christian traditions to signify devotion and reverence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cyrielle carries a rich cultural history, as it originated from the Greek language. It was adopted into various European languages, such as French, and has been used for centuries. In many cultures, particularly in Europe, the name carries a sense of nobility and grace, as it was given to girls born into upper class or royal families. Today, the name is known and cherished for its unique and beautiful sound.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Cyrielle holds a deep spiritual significance, as it is rooted in the Greek word Kyrios, meaning 'Lord'. This name reflects a strong connection to the Christian faith, as it can be interpreted as 'Sun of God' or 'Lady of the Lord'. For those who choose this name for their child, it represents a deep devotion and commitment to their faith, as well as a desire to raise their child with strong spiritual values. By embracing the meaning behind the name, Cyrielle carries a powerful reminder of the divine love, compassion, and power that is the foundation of the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cyrielle, meaning "lordful, circular, or dark haired one," is a name that symbolizes the divine feminine in Christianity. It evokes the image of the Virgin Mary, the embodiment of God's love and motherhood, with her dark locks and her circular, nurturing form. This name is a reminder of the cyclical nature of life and the constant presence of God in all things.

historical_references.context: Cyrielle was a common name for Christian girls during the early Middle Ages.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
